source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When a rule lets you split a unit into smaller units:

- Split it into 2 units as equal in size as possible, noting which models form each.
- Models already split can’t be split again.
- A split before the battle sets each new unit’s **starting strength** to its own number of models.
- If a starting strength the rule states for the new units can’t be met, such as because of attached Leader or Support models, use the even split instead.
